name: Barnaby
personality: Big, polite, and always ordering for his whole family.

lines.text: Good evening! Barnaby speaking. Sorry about the noise, the cubs are excited.
Hello, hello! Barnaby here, from the big house up the hill.
We'd love the [dish], please. Extra napkins. Lots of extra napkins.
The [dish], please. It's for sharing. Well. It's meant to be for sharing.
The little one wants to know if the chef has a hat.

choices.reply: She just gasped. You're her hero now.

choices.text: Not yet, but I'm saving up.
choices.reply: Ha! She says to get a red one.
